ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 45 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.note: For example "2 d ago". "d" abbreviates days. Plural: English has one/other only. ru needs few/many; ar needs zero/two/few/many; supply every arm your language requires and keep # where the number belongs.

placeholders.days: Whole days since the event (1 or more).

ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.role: Row meta text for a connected integration
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 19 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.note: Status word, middle dot, tool count, for example "Connected · 12 tools".

placeholders.tools: Already-localized tool count phrase, for example "12 tools". Insert verbatim.

ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.role: Row meta text after a successful use
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.

ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.note: For example "Worked 5 min ago · 12 tools".

placeholders.when: Already-localized relative time, for example "5 min ago" or "just now".

ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.role: Row meta text after an earlier successful use of unknown date
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 24 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.note: For example "Worked earlier · 12 tools".

ui.settings.integrations.integration_mod.note: For example "12 tools when last checked".

ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.role: Empty-state line for a deep link
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.tone: Calm, factual sentence; no blame, no alarm.
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 33 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.note: Shown when the integration the link asked for does not exist.

placeholders.asked: The integration name from the link. Insert verbatim between the straight quotes.

ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.role: Notice above the list for a deep link that did not match
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.tone: Calm, factual sentence; no blame, no alarm.
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 62 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.note: Says the list falls back to another integration because the one asked for is not one of the user's.

placeholders.asked: The integration name from the link that did not match.
placeholders.shown: Name of the integration that is shown instead.

ui.settings.integrations.use_integration.role: Error message after saving keys failed
ui.settings.integrations.use_integration.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.integrations.use_integration.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 53 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.use_integration.note: Names the keys that were not saved and says the encrypted store may be locked.

placeholders.keys: Comma-separated list of key names. Insert verbatim; the names are identifiers.

ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.tone: Plain imperative; no exclamation, no please.
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.length: Placeholder inside an empty input; clipped at the input width (~24-40 characters). English is 21 characters.
ui.settings.integrations.mcp_management_.note: Introduces a count phrase such as "5 integrations".

placeholders.integrations: Already-localized count phrase, for example "5 integrations". Insert verbatim.
